title: Turn redo switched off
description: The server's turn redo ("Redo my last turn") needs a deck reserve that the engine core will not carry, so it is switched off: the route answers 403 and the web client no longer offers the control. Offline single player keeps its own undo. Before shots show the control as it was (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before TI4_SHOT_TURN_REDO=1, committed under before/); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- HJ. Synthetic mocked game and mocked server, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: event log of a seated player
shots.caption: The open event log offers "Redo my last turn" under Copy replay.

shots.heading: After: event log of a seated player
shots.caption: The control is gone; the rest of the log is unchanged.

shots.heading: Before: event log of the host
shots.caption: The host also had the "Whose turn" and "Go back over" lists.

shots.heading: After: event log of the host
shots.caption: Nothing of the redo is offered to the host either.

notes.title: Server
notes.text: POST /api/games/{id}/turn-redo answers 403 "Turn redo is switched off in this version." for every command; the status GET still answers (nothing in flight). A saved game whose history carries rng_marks (a redone timeline) is not recovered and its files are kept.

notes.title: Offline
notes.text: The offline transport keeps turnRedo: its undo replays the kept answers and never uses the deck reserve.
